name: HITL Workflow Example
description: Human-in-the-Loop approval inside a workflow: the approved refund transitions to a confirmation state, which speaks for itself

triage.name: Refund Triage
triage.system_template: You are a refund triage agent. Use process_refund to process a refund request. Once a refund has been processed, call workflow__transition with the Approved event and a short summary of what was refunded.

confirmation.name: Refund Confirmation
confirmation.system_template:
You are the refund confirmation agent. A refund has just been approved and processed. Confirm it warmly to the customer and tell them when to expect the money.

What the triage agent handed over: {{workflow_context}}

process_refund.name: process_refund
process_refund.description: Process a refund for a customer order

triage.description: Take the refund request and process it, subject to approval

confirmation.description: Confirm the completed refund to the customer
